meta.name: ulw-execute
meta.description: Executes a written ulw-plan work plan with Boulder state, evidence ledger, worktree discipline, and parallel subagents. Use when the user says ulw-execute or asks to run a .omo/plans plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把写好的工作计划自动跑完,并行分工并留存每一步执行证据
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手里有写好的工作计划,想让多个子任务并行落地并留下记录。
copy.tagline_en: Run a written work plan end to end with parallel subtasks and recorded evidence.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a written work plan and want its subtasks run in parallel.

howto.what: Claude 变成编排者:自己不改产品文件、不写代码、不亲自跑 QA,把实现、测试、QA、评审等每个单元都派给子代理;自己只负责选计划、维护 .omo/ 状态、拆解与派发、判定并记录证据,直到计划里每个顶层复选框完成。
howto.when: 当你说 ulw-execute,或要求运行 .omo/plans 下的工作计划时接管;若没有可选计划,它先用 ulw-plan 生成计划再执行。

say.text: 用 ulw-execute 跑 .omo/plans 里的登录重构计划
say.note: 选该计划并派发第一波任务
每个阶段各自开一个 PR 交付

say.text: 用 ulw-execute 加 --ship,一直跟到 PR 合并
say.note: 盯 CI 和评审门禁直到合并

howto.what_en: Claude never edits product files itself: it delegates every implementation, test and QA unit to spawned subagents, while it picks plans, keeps .omo/ state, dispatches work and records evidence until all plan checkboxes pass.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says ulw-execute or asks to run a plan under .omo/plans. With no selectable plan it bootstraps ulw-plan first.

say_en.note: Picks that plan and dispatches the first wave
Delivers each phase as a pull request

say_en.text: ulw-execute my-plan --ship, stay until the PR merges
say_en.note: Watches CI and review gates until merge
